# Card 373: preliminary single-reader candidate

[Catalogue](https://crypto.hcportal.eu/dashboard/cryptograms/1692) · [Picture original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5136/pc_hcp_373_pic.JPG) · [Address original](https://api.hcportal.eu/media/5137/pc_hcp_373_adr.JPG) · [Full evidence JSON](373.json)

**Partial research candidate; not a solved card.** One key-visible AI source reading was frozen before the first computational decode. Subsequent source review and interpretation used the same context and were nonblind. A second source reading and external confirmation are still needed.

Two opposite-orientation six-row blocks; their overall reading order unresolved. Black occlusions remain masks of unknown length. Multiple underlines visible; no semantic role assigned. Ordinary date excluded.

The original images/crops remain private. Picture SHA256: `df614ea46f7221ee9f77a3dbaf27744cb0ee0e925c02a7f88004ef4b1564e1b9`. Coordinates and full acquisition metadata are in the JSON. Ordinary dates, addresses and postal text are excluded without historical authentication.

## Readable fragments

These are separate editorial proposals tied to exact literal fragments. They are not a continuous translation; omitted stretches remain unresolved. Czech diacritics are editorial.

**373-lower-1**, literal `SRDECNY DI? ?A DNESNI LISTE?`

proposed_czech:
Srdečný dík za dnešní lístek. Slečně Kankové [odeslal?] jsem lístek v sobotu (současně s lístkem Tobě) do Hradce. Pokud se týče splnění jejího [přání?], napsala mi Anička, že píše proto tak tajemně, [abych?] její přání nemohl splniti. Musím [tudíž?] souditi, že si splnění jeho ode mne [nepřeje?]. Zajisté bych rád vyplnil její přání tak, pokud jest v mé moci. Na setkání se velice [těším?]. Toužím po tom, bych opět mohl hlouběji [nahlédnouti?] do Tvé dušičky a zaplašiti tak [rozmanité?] pochybnosti.

Tisíc vřelých pus ti [posílá?] tvůj Pepouš. Kdy máte odpověď?
proposed_english:
Heartfelt thanks for today’s letter. I [sent?] Miss Kanková a little letter on Saturday (at the same time as the one to you) to Hradec. As regards fulfilling her [wish?], Anička wrote to me that she writes so mysteriously so that I [might] not fulfil her wish. I must [therefore?] conclude that she [does not wish?] me to fulfil it. I would certainly gladly fulfil her wish, insofar as it is in my power. I am greatly [looking forward?] to our meeting. I long to be able once again to look more deeply into your little soul and thus dispel such [varied?] doubts.

Your Pepouš [sends?] you a thousand warm kisses. When will you have an answer?
